WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM qualifying AS q WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId
  )
  GROUP BY c.location
),
shares AS (
  SELECT city, race_count,
         CAST(race_count AS REAL) / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT city,
       race_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
ORDER BY city
